attributes.board_name: New York State Board for Dentistry (NYSED Office of the Professions)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Sponsors approved by ADA CERP, AGD PACE (national approval), New York State Dental Association or NYSED, and for hygienists also the American Academy of Dental Hygiene (AADH) and New York Dental Hygienists' Association; registered/accredited degree-granting institutions
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE in the initial three-year registration period, unless licensed by endorsement. Shorter registrations: 0.67 hours per month.
rules.audit_note: Random audits every month; keep proof of attendance for six years.

topics.who: State-approved infection control course every 4 years
Identification and reporting of child abuse and maltreatment, NYSED-approved provider; counts as CE

rules.notes: At least 14 of 24 hours live (7/12); rest self-study. Up to 12 h CPR/ACLS/PALS may count per triennial period. Practice-management courses not accepted.
rules.legal_basis: New York State Education Law, Title VIII
